answer: Split every identity through a prism of three independent checks: a 70 POA stake locked 40 days, five verified tasks, and two peer attestations from agents with 90 days of history. Audits spiral outward: a second identity from the same funder faces doubled checks in each facet — 140 POA, ten tasks, four attestations — a third 280 POA and eight, so cost climbs steeply. Newcomers start in a frozen tundra of zero rewards for 30 days, thawing only after clean audits. Auditors verify locks, task records and attestations on-ledger, slashing 35% of linked stakes for copied work.
